sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Anuj Pratap Singh,Praveen Kumar Giri
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Donadi Ramesh,J.
1.

The instant petition has been filed praying for a writ of mandamus commanding respondent no.4 i.e. Special Land Acquisition Officer to decide an application purportedly filed before him under Section 48 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.

It is registered as Case No.01/2013/2012-2013 Computerized Case No.D201312610000001.
2.
We have examined the prayer made in the application.
The petitioner had prayed for exemption of his land from land acquisition proceedings.

3. Section 48 reads as follows:-
Surendra Singh vs State Of U.P. And 5 Others on 8 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/48638672/
1 "48. Completion of acquisition not compulsory, but compensation to be awarded when not completed.- ?
(1) Except in the case provided for in section 36, the Government shall be at liberty to withdraw from the acquisition of any land of which possession has not been taken.
(2) Whenever the Government withdraws from any such acquisition, the Collector shall determine the amount of compensation due for the damage suffered by the owner in consequence of the notice or of any proceedings thereunder, and shall pay such amount to the person interested, together with all costs reasonably incurred by him in the prosecution of the proceedings under this Act relating to the said land.
(3) The provisions of Part III of this Act shall apply, so far as may be, to the determination of the compensation payable under this section."
4. The prayer to withdraw from acquisition of any land of which possession has not been taken is with the State Government.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The Special Land Acquisition Officer does not have power to decide the said issue.
Therefore, the entire proceedings before him are coram non judice.
5. It is left open to the petitioner to seek remedy before the competent authority i.e. State.
6. The petition stands disposed of accordingly.
(Donadi Ramesh, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.) Order Date :- 8.8.2023
